decision_conditions: <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">The proposed front dormer windows, by reason of their scale, siting, design, bulk and mass would be an undesirable addition&nbsp;to the existing dwelling. The proposal fails to preserve the existing character of the dwelling and pattern of development. As such, the cumulative impact of the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to&nbsp;the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design:&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)<br>- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)<br>- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)<br>- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)</span></p>

<div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed single storey side and rear extension would result in unacceptable loss of daylight, overshadowing,<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;loss of outlook and overbearing impacts</span>&nbsp;impacts to no.26 Mayfair Avenue. Therefore, the proposal would constitute unneighbourly development which is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);<o:p></o:p></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span><o:p></o:p></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and DMSI3 of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024); and</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a single storey side and rear extension and the addition of two front dormer windows and one roof light to the front
